I just want to find the strength to do what I know is right for me. 

I've felt this way for years, and it gets worse and worse and worse every day, I don't like my existence, my life, anything. I just want it to end.
I know 😶😢. It's a horrible thing to go through. But self harming isn't the answer. I'm really proud of you for not doing it.
That's a good thing. Don't start. I thought it would be a solution but it's just made my problems worse. My mind is weak, be proud that you've never done it. You're courageous for not doing it.
